id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a suspended snowflake destination account

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Snowflake warehouse ingestion error handling and test coverage for account suspension (errno 666), improving warehouse connector reliability and user diagnostics.
review.reason: Adds a test assertion and runtime check for Snowflake account suspension error, returning a specific user-facing message. This could help users distinguish account suspension from other warehouse configuration errors.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the warehouse ingestion pipeline correctly identifying account suspension; no established adoption or incident avoidance is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a test and implementation change for Snowflake warehouse destination error handling. No adoption, incident, or benefit is established. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case for errno 666, expecting the error message to be classified as 'suspended'.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a test assertion for a Snowflake-specific error code, checking that the warehouse ingestion pipeline correctly identifies account suspension as a configuration error.

observations.behavior: Defines a new error detail string for account suspension and associates it with errno 666.
